app.name: VI Mode Test
app.long_description: Boots at the console's normal video mode and lists 24 test resolutions (240p, 480i, 480p, 960i, 1080i, 720p, double-wide chroma, 1440-wide and 120 Hz variants). Selecting one programs the VI timing and, where needed, the VI PLL directly, then shows test patterns (D-pad). Each mode's real line and field rate are measured and logged to vimodetest.txt. START (GC pad) or HOME / + (Wii Remote) returns to the list at the safe mode. Clock registers reset on power-off.
